ant_scale_atlas.name: One pattern, three sizes
ant_scale_atlas.description: Original pheromone-grid, turmite and Ant Colony V2 simulations at 45 cm, 1.8 m and 8 m. Carry the same PointBody; pause, compare and restart explicitly.
ant_scale_atlas.qfep_connection: A shared pattern can become a thing held or a ground crossed. Scale changes the encounter; it does not establish that two different rules describe the same organism.
